=SELECT create_approval_token(CAST('{{ $json.workflow_id }}' AS UUID), CAST('{{ $json.approver_id }}' AS BIGINT), {{ $json.step_number }}, '{{ $json.approval_token }}', '{{ $json.token_expiry }}'::TIMESTAMP) as token_id

parameters.jsCode:
// Format email notification for approval request const data = $node['Generate Approval Token'].json || {}; const emailHtml = `

📄 Contract Approval Required

Dear ${data.approver_name},

A new contract requires your approval at ${data.level_name}:

Contract Number: ${data.contract_number || 'N/A'}
Created by: ${data.creator_name || 'Unknown'}
Total Amount: ${data.total_amount ? new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN', {style: 'currency', currency: 'VND'}).format(data.total_amount) : 'N/A'}
Approval Level: ${data.level_name} (Level ${data.level})
Expires in: ${data.timeout_hours} hours

Please review and take action:

✅ Approve ❌ Reject

This approval link will expire in ${data.timeout_hours} hours.
If you have any questions, please contact the contract creator: ${data.creator_email}

Best regards,
OrientClassicsManager System

`; return { json: { to: data.approver_email, subject: `📄 Contract Approval Required: ${data.contract_number} - ${data.level_name}`, html: emailHtml, text: `Contract ${data.contract_number} requires your approval at ${data.level_name}. Amount: ${data.total_amount ? new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN', {style: 'currency', currency: 'VND'}).format(data.total_amount) : 'N/A'}. Approve: ${data.approve_url} | Reject: ${data.reject_url}`, // Keep all data for next nodes ...data } };
